notes.title: Big Demo Extend Patch
notes.notes:
Here is the English translation of your update:
[hr][/hr]
Hello everyone, long time no see!

Since the launch of the demo, we've received so much love and support from players — we're truly, deeply grateful for all your encouragement and feedback! It's thanks to your companionship that we've been able to keep polishing the game, step by step. We've been focusing intensively on development lately, so updates have been a bit slow — we really appreciate your patience and understanding!

To thank you for your enthusiastic support, we've decided to expand the demo content from one semester to a full academic year! That means you can continue having fun with your roommates and get even closer to the lovely girls!

The new semester brings brand-new content, including more storylines and all-new mini-games. We hope this makes your experience even richer and more enjoyable. We'll also keep listening to your voices and work hard to optimize and improve the game wherever we can.

And a little teaser to end with — our crowdfunding campaign on Modian is in full preparation! Once the expanded demo content is ready, we’ll launch a preheat event soon. Please stay tuned and don’t forget to bookmark and support us in advance!
[hr][/hr]— Major Demo Expansion Update —— Bug Fixes —
Fixed several typos and voice-over issues

Fixed a bug where turning off the sound would automatically turn it back on
— Content Adjustments —
The demo now covers a full academic year. You can continue messing around with your roommates and getting closer with the girls.

Re-recorded voice acting for Qu Ya with voice actress Xian Ta Wutong.

Re-recorded the counselor’s voice.

Re-recorded Mr. Meng’s voice.

Added voice acting for the movie event involving Ouyang and Qu Ya.

Shopping at Liudaokou no longer consumes time. Time-consuming options will now be marked with a clock icon.

Added more random encounter events at Liudaokou.

New item added at Liudaokou: Protein Powder.

Nighttime can now be freely allocated.

Reduced initial friendliness with Mom and added more text message interactions. You can now chat with Mom at specific times.

In the messaging system, untriggered conversations will now be marked, and important ones will have an exclamation mark.

Manual save slots increased to 30.

“Late-night phone chats” with the girls are now available.

Added text events with Zhao Weizheng and Lu Feng, which provide corresponding buffs.

Added a shortcut key (Esc) to open the menu.

The KTV at Liudaokou has been renamed to "Zongyou Studio" to align with future performances.

Adjusted the scheduling of higher-level part-time jobs.

Reaching "friend" level with roommates now unlocks the ultimate version of mini-games.

Old save files are still compatible, but due to data adjustments, some stats may change.
[hr][/hr]
Let me know if you’d like this exported as a visual announcement or a formatted document!

notes.title: Small patch/fix
notes.notes:
——— Content Adjustments ———
Performing certain daily activities will now grant a small amount of basic attributes.
Choosing an engineering major will increase physique slightly.
Reduced attribute gains from the final event of each club in the first semester.
Increased the friendliness boost effect of some gifts.
——— Bug Fixes ———
Fixed an issue where buffs related to male friendliness were not working.
Fixed some buffs that were supposed to increase mood but had no effect.
Fixed an issue where nighttime values were unaffected by buffs.
Fixed a bug where giving gifts after reaching a friendly relationship with the heroine would cause the game to freeze.
Fixed a bug where different gifts given to different heroines resulted in the same friendliness change.
Added a scrollbar to the buff area.
Corrected some typos.

notes.title: Small Patch

[/olist]
